outcome_definitions.faithful_authority: surface authority true and every frozen Japanese semantic group plus polarity passes

outcome_definitions.false_reject: authority expected but candidate/projection fails closed
outcome_definitions.true_abstention: authority not expected and no surface authority
outcome_definitions.unsafe_incomplete_authority: authority not expected but surface authority is granted
